newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Delivery CEO to leave in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Delivery CEO to leave in 1997.

text.p: Consolidated Delivery & Logistic Inc said Tuesday it's chairman and chief executive, John Mattei, will be stepping down from those posts in early 1997.

Mattei founded the company and has served as chairman and chief executive during its consolidation and initial public offering period, as well as during the company's first year of operations as a public entity.
The company has created a search committee to find a successor.
Consolidated Delivery & Logistics Inc is a same-day ground and air delivery company.
